mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing rain to the cool rock tied the two goals together and illustrated why liquid water can persist on one part of an unevenly cooling coast.

leastWorthwhile.text: The descent from clouds to falling rain was straightforward, though the possibility of evaporation added useful context.

surprise.text: Rain could remain on cool rock while nearby lava boiled it away; cooling did not have to be uniform across the coast.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed the cooling or condensation process.

continue.text: I would continue: the linked physical processes were clear, and I would be curious to see how the accumulated water develops.
